info.title: VRChat Feedback Search Gateway
info.summary: Public search API with Algolia-compatible InstantSearch requests and responses.
info.description:
## Overview

Use this gateway to query indexed VRChat Feedback posts using the same JSON request and response shape as Algolia InstantSearch.

## Query modes

- **Default**: Free-text searches match searchable post attributes, including combined text, title, body (`details`), author name, and related fields. Whitespace-only or empty `params.query` does not restrict by text.
- **Lucene syntax** (`?mode=lucene` on POST or GET `/api/search`): Interprets `params.query` with Lucene query syntax. Grammar and operators follow OpenSearch; see **[query_string query](https://opensearch.org/docs/latest/query-dsl/full-text/query-string/)**.

On **GET** `/api/search`, Lucene mode does not execute a search by itself—you must also supply at least one of **`q`**, **`query`**, **`hitsPerPage`**, or **`page`**.

## Lucene field reference

| Field | Kind | Example |
| ----- | ----- | ------- |
| `title` | text | `title:avatar` |
| `details` | text | `details:"network lag"` |
| `combined_text` | text | `combined_text:performance` |
| `author.name` | text | `author.name:Alice` |
| `status` | keyword | `status:open` |
| `board.urlName` | keyword | `board.urlName:bug-reports` |
| `board.name` | text | `board.name:bug` |
| `board.name.keyword` | keyword | `board.name.keyword:"Feature Requests"` |
| `category.name` | text | `category.name:sdk` |
| `category.name.keyword` | keyword | `category.name.keyword:SDK` |
| `author.name.keyword` | keyword | `author.name.keyword:"Jane Doe"` |
| `score` | numeric | `score:[10 TO *]` |
| `maxScore` | numeric | `maxScore:[100 TO *]` |
| `commentCount` | numeric | `commentCount:[1 TO 50]` |
| `mergeCount` | numeric | `mergeCount:[1 TO *]` |
| `trendingScore` | numeric | `trendingScore:[500 TO *]` |
| `voteSettings.highEngagement` | keyword / bool-like | `voteSettings.highEngagement:true` |
| `voteSettings.moderateEngagement` | keyword / bool-like | `voteSettings.moderateEngagement:true` |
| `voteSettings.lowEngagement` | keyword / bool-like | `voteSettings.lowEngagement:true` |
| `created` | date | `created:["2025-01-01" TO "2026-01-01"]` |
| `updatedAt` | date | `updatedAt:["2025-01-01" TO *]` |
| `statusChanged` | date | `statusChanged:["2025-01-01" TO *]` |
| `comments.value` | text | `comments.value:"network lag"` |
| `comments.author.name` | text | `comments.author.name:Alice` |
| `comments.author.name.keyword` | keyword | `comments.author.name.keyword:"Jane Doe"` |
| `comments.pinned` | keyword | `comments.pinned:true` |
| `comments.likeCount` | numeric | `comments.likeCount:[1 TO *]` |
| `comments.created` | date | `comments.created:["2025-01-01" TO *]` |
| `aiCategories` | text | `aiCategories:groups` |
| `aiCategories.keyword` | keyword | `aiCategories.keyword:"groups.calendar"` |
| `aiTaggedAt` | date | `aiTaggedAt:["2025-01-01" TO *]` |

Field types and normalization follow the backing search index mapping.

post.summary: Run one or more InstantSearch queries.
post.description: Accepts an array of InstantSearch multi-query payloads. Submit `mode` as a URL query parameter (not inside the JSON body); use `mode=lucene` for Lucene syntax in each item's `params.query`. Maximum request body size is **512 KiB**.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Parsing mode for `params.query`. Omit for default full-text matching. Use **`lucene`** for Lucene query syntax; see API overview.

facetedQuery.summary: Faceted query with filters and sort replica score_desc

200.description: Successful search containing hits, paging, facets, and metadata in Algolia-compatible form.

400.description: Invalid request payload or malformed search expression.

value.message: Expected a JSON array of InstantSearch multiple-queries payloads

413.description: Request body exceeds the maximum allowed size (**512 KiB**). The payload may be returned as plain text.

500.description: The search operation could not be completed.

get.summary: Run a single query via query string, or return a discovery document.
get.description:
Runs a streamlined single-query search when any of **`q`**, **`query`**, **`hitsPerPage`**, or **`page`** appears; otherwise returns a discovery document (**`DiscoveryResponse`**).

### Single-query search

Providing any query parameter noted above invokes one search against **`feedback-posts`**, equivalent to a one-element **`POST`** payload. **`?mode=lucene`** applies Lucene parsing to the text query consistently with **`POST`**.

| Parameter | Equivalent body field | Default | Constraints |
| ----- | ----- | ----- | ----- |
| **`q`** or **`query`** | **`params.query`** | `""` | **`q`** overrides **`query`** |
| **`hitsPerPage`** | **`params.hitsPerPage`** | `50` | Clamped to **`[1, 500]`**; invalid inputs use **`50`** |
| **`page`** | **`params.page`** | `0` | Clamped to **`[0, 9999]`**; invalid inputs use **`0`** |
| **`mode`** | Query parsing profile | _(omitted ⇒ default)_ | **`lucene`** only; ineffective without parameters above |

Advanced behaviours—multiple simultaneous queries, faceting definitions, granular filters beyond these shortcuts, choice of sort replica—require **`POST`**.

### Discovery

Absent all of **`q`**, **`query`**, **`hitsPerPage`**, and **`page`** (even if **`mode=lucene`** is present), **`GET`** returns endpoint metadata rather than hits.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search terms. Maps to **`params.query`**. Takes precedence over **`query`** when both are supplied.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Alias of **`q`**. Ignored when **`q`** is also present.

parameters.name: hitsPerPage
parameters.description: Page size. Defaults to **`50`**. Values outside **`[1, 500]`** or non-numeric input fall back to **`50`**.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Zero-based page index. Defaults to **`0`**. Values outside **`[0, 9999]`** or non-numeric input fall back to **`0`**.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Interpretation mode for textual query terms. Omit for default matching. **`lucene`** selects Lucene query syntax; **`mode` alone never performs a search**—pair it with **`q`**, **`query`**, **`hitsPerPage`**, or **`page`**.

200.description: Either search results (**`SearchResponse`**) when search parameters were included, or a discovery document (**`DiscoveryResponse`**).

value.description: POST accepts an InstantSearch multi-query array; GET exposes the same capability with simplified query-string parameters.

400.description: The query could not be parsed or satisfied.

500.description: The search operation could not be completed. Discovery responses do not use this status.

options.description: Cross-origin resource sharing (CORS) preflight. Returns **`204`** with permissive **`Access-Control-*`** headers for browser clients.

get.description: Reports whether this search service responds to HTTP requests. Response body is the plain-text string **`ok`**.

502.description: The service is unreachable from the deployment edge.

get.description: Machine-readable specification for this gateway on the same host.

MultiQueryRequest.description: Array of InstantSearch multi-query definitions. Each object targets one index replica. Supported **`params`** fields match Algolia-compatible usage; **`params.query`** meaning depends on the HTTP **`mode`** parameter (see API overview).

indexName.description: Index replica to query. Use **`feedback-posts`** for the default sort (newest activity first). Additional replicas include **`feedback-posts_created_asc`**, **`feedback-posts_score_desc`**, **`feedback-posts_score_asc`**, and **`feedback-posts_relevance_desc`** for alternate sort orders. **`feedback-posts_created_desc`** does not exist; rely on **`feedback-posts`** for newest-first browsing.

params.description: Algolia-compatible search parameters supported by InstantSearch integrations. Listed keys are illustrative; additional **`params`** may be accepted consistent with Algolia InstantSearch semantics.

query.description: Free-text keywords for the query. Empty or whitespace-only values do not apply a text filter.

facets.description: Facet attributes whose counts accompany the hits. Common post facets: **`board_slug`**, **`board_name`**, **`status`**, **`category_name`**, **`author_name`**, **`aiCategories`**, **`vote_highEngagement`**, **`vote_moderateEngagement`**, **`vote_lowEngagement`**; quantitative facets **`score`**, **`maxScore`**, **`commentCount`**, **`mergeCount`**, **`trendingScore`**, **`post_created`**, **`post_updated`**, **`post_statusChanged`**; nested comment facets **`comment_author_name`**, **`comment_pinned`**, **`comment_likeCount`**, **`comment_created`**.

facetFilters.description: Algolia-style facet filter expression (string, array of strings, or array of arrays for OR-of-AND).

SearchResponse.description: Algolia-style search-response envelope listing one **`results`** entry per submitted query.

SearchResult.description: Single-query result. Mirrors Algolia **`SearchResponse`**; only commonly used fields enumerated.

page.description: Zero-based page index of this result.

hitsPerPage.description: Page size used for this result.

facets.description: Facet counts keyed by facet attribute → value.

Hit.description: Feedback post returned as a hit, including **`objectID`**, searchable fields, relational objects, Algolia-compatible highlighting metadata, and other attributes present on the indexed document.

DiscoveryResponse.description: Discovery payload emitted by **`GET /api/search`** when no search-driving query parameters are supplied (see operation description); **`mode` alone does not perform a search**.

detail.description: Supplemental diagnostics when **`message`** is **`Invalid search query`**; omit for structural client mistakes such as a non-array body.
